note: Both sets capture the core datum labels (T.O. STEEL 11'-4", FIRST FLR 2'-4", SOLAR ENVELOPE 18'-0") and the member sections, but Set B misbinds several conditions: it treats C4 (a column mark) as a grid line, calls C1 a 'Detail', places L4X4X5/16 and 2'-0" in the C1 elevation where the text layer does not show them, and gives 'between grid D and C1' as a span condition. Set A's errors are fewer and milder: it rounds 27'-8" to '27 ft' in one claim, invents the 'grid lines 4 and 8' condition for the 27'-8" overall dimension, and labels a PL3"X1/4" a 'gusset plate'. Set A also keeps useful relational conditions (elevations relative to Grade Level, L4X4X5/16 in the South Elevation) that Set B only partly matches, though A includes some vague 'Structural Member' claims.
